title: Friendsgiving Ideas: Food, Games, and Traditions
claim: A Friendsgiving planning guide lists '2016 Friendsgiving' as a theme, built on the 2026 social trend of sharing 2016 fashion, music and online trends
excerpt: A social media trend that took off in early 2026 had people sharing the fashion, music, and online trends of 2016... play a 2016 playlist, dig up an old group photo and recreate it, and serve the snacks your group ate back then.
